target: PO-GEO-001A through PO-GEO-001D — advance from defined_pending_explicit_check to explicit_defined
purpose: Define the minimum formal terms required for L099 symbolic checking while preserving the geometry_app hard cap.
governance_note: This patch moves the symbolic machinery from prepared to explicitly defined. It does not prove Pi_geo, validate geometry_app, or discharge GEO-CAMPAIGN-001.

definitions.name: Domain of Pi_geo
definitions.admission_rule: T must carry all four invariant labels (distinction_class, admissibility_status, orientation_class, closure_class) in Trace_geo(T) before entry

definitions.name: Codomain of Pi_geo
definitions.forbidden_reading: NOT physical space, metric manifold, field content, or matter content
definitions.admission_rule: G enters Cod only if tau_geo(G) returns all four labels without conflict or alias

definitions.name: Topology-Origin Trace Record
definitions.rule: All fields mandatory; no field may be inferred after projection

conditions: TAU-UNDEF-1: G not produced by Pi_geo
TAU-UNDEF-3: any label conflicts with Trace_geo(T) ground truth
TAU-UNDEF-4: closure_class aliased across distinct T objects

definitions.name: Geometry_app equivalence relation
definitions.constraint: Coarser than or equal to topology equivalence — may not collapse distinct topology classes

sub_obligation_explicit_checks.explicit_check: tau_geo(Pi_geo(T)).closure_class == Trace_geo(T).closure_class AND closure_class mapping injective across T objects

next_gate.requirement: Explicit confirmation that all four check conditions hold and no failure mode is suppressed under the declared definitions. No simulation required at this gate.
next_gate.geometry_app_note: geometry_app remains C1_STRUCTURAL_PROJECTION_ONLY even after symbolic_checked; GEO-CAMPAIGN-001 must pass separately
